args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

round_money documented banker's rounding but implemented
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing test_half_even to fail (e.g. 2.665
rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66). Under ROUND_HALF_EVEN,
exact halves round to the nearest even cent.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
- Nightly build failure: `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money::round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so exact halves round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665` → `2.66`, `2.675` → `2.68`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed**.

Fixes the NightlyBuild failure.
